name: Wish Me Well
description:
About This Game

Jump into the Magic Well to enter the world of books. Traverse procedurally generated arcane dungeons, fight unique ink monsters and become a powerful wizard who gathered all the wisdom.

Combine magical scrolls and spells found in the books to craft a customizable magic gun as you descend deeper into the well. Create a single, devastating projectile unleashing immense destruction in a single strike or trigger a chain of projectiles one after another. Experiment with builds to reach mastery.

With each run, unlock new items, spells and dungeon rooms that permanently expand future playthroughs. Level up your wizard and adapt your builds to face new challenges.

Play. Improve. Repeat.

Every run is a unique experience. Unlock new scrolls, discover powerful spell combinations and synergies and create builds that best suit your playstyle.

Main features

  • Create a custom magic gun using powerful spell combinations

  • Procedurally generated levels ensure no two runs are the same

  • Fight ink monsters and challenging bosses

  • Unlock dozens of scrolls and magical items

  • Easy-to-learn combat system

About the Starrow Castles Team

Hi! We're Adrian and Krzysztof, two friends creating this game. We've put a lot of love and determination into making our dream come true with our very first title - Wish Me Well.

Please keep in mind that we're very small studio at the beginning of game-creating journey and while we've done our best to give you the best possible experience it may have its flaws.

Thank you for giving us and our game a try and have fun playing it!
short_desc: Craft magical weapons. Uncover synergies. Unleash your creativity. A top-down weapon-building roguelite dungeon crawler. Jump into the Magic Well, gather powerful scrolls, build your magical weapon and fight unique ink monsters your way!
